methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
WHO IRIS (Institutional Repository for Information Sharing) is the World Health Organization's DSpace 7 repository, exposing ~33,700+ items on a query for 'malaria' alone (total corpus is far larger). It holds Governing Bodies documents, technical documents, journal articles, publications and meeting reports. Access is via the standard DSpace 7 Discovery REST API and requires no authentication for reads.

## Search
GET `https://iris.who.int/server/api/discover/search/objects` with `query=<terms>`, `dsoType=item`, `page` (0-based), `size` (page size), and `sort` (e.g. `dc.date.issued,DESC`). Results live under `_embedded.searchResult._embedded.objects[]._embedded.indexableObject`, each carrying `uuid`, `name` and a `metadata` map. Total count is at `_embedded.searchResult.page.totalElements`.

## Filters
Apply DSpace facet filters as query params. Verified working: `f.itemtype=Publications,equals` (document type; returned 3891 hits), `f.dateIssued=[2020 TO 2023],equals` (date range; URL-encode brackets; returned 2276 hits). Additional facets exposed by the API: `author`, `mesh`, `publisher`, `subject`, `series`, `entityType`, `language`, `has_content_in_original_bundle`. Multiple `f.*` params can be combined.

## Download
Full PDFs are DSpace bitstreams. Chain: `GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}/bundles` -> pick bundle `ORIGINAL` -> `GET /server/api/core/bundles/{bundleUuid}/bitstreams` -> follow `_links.content.href`, i.e. `/server/api/core/bitstreams/{bitstreamUuid}/content`. Use HTTP GET (verified 200, application/pdf); a HEAD request returns 500.

## Metadata & Enrichment
`GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}` returns the complete Dublin Core metadata block. Useful fields: `dc.identifier.govdoc` (WHO document symbol), `dc.identifier.uri` (handle), `dc.subject.mesh` (MeSH terms), `dc.type`, `dc.language.iso`, `who.relation.languageVersion` (links to translations). Machine-extracted full text is available via the `TEXT` bundle for downstream indexing.

## Limitations
WebFetch is blocked by a WAF (HTTP 403); a browser-like User-Agent via direct HTTP client works. Facet-value listing endpoints (e.g. `/discover/facets/language`) require a search context and may 400 when called bare. Item-type labels are inconsistently cased in the index, so exact-match filters should account for case variants.

Facets returned: author, mesh, dateIssued, has_content_in_original_bundle, entityType, publisher, subject, series, itemtype. GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid} -> 200 metadata. GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}/bundles -> ORIGINAL/LICENSE/TEXT/THUMBNAIL. GET /server/api/core/bundles/{orig}/bitstreams -> A60_R18-en.pdf, content link followed with GET -> 200 %PDF-1.4 18899 bytes. GET /discover/facets/itemtype -> value list (Publications, Journal articles, etc.). Filter tests: f.itemtype=Publications,equals -> 200 total 3891; f.dateIssued=[2020 TO 2023],equals -> 200 total 2276 (note: f.dateIssued.min/.max style returned 422). sort=dc.date.issued,DESC -> 200. HEAD on bitstream content -> 500 (use GET). WebFetch on iris.who.int -> 403 (WAF).
